errors.description: The welt sits a little lower under the waistband than the blueprint draws it: about four welt-heights below the waistband seam in the photograph against roughly one and a half in the drawing.

errors.actual: Welt top edge about four welt-heights below the waistband seam.

errors.description: The bottom edge of the frame is still further below the welt than the framing lock asked for, so roughly the lower half of the picture is plain front-panel cloth.

errors.actual: Bottom edge roughly ten welt-heights below the welt.
errors.correction: Could be tightened another notch; the welt already spans over half the picture width and reads instantly.

notes: Blueprint: trouser front three-quarter with ONE small horizontal welt just below the waistband on the wearer's left, sitting directly beneath a belt loop whose tail runs down and is tacked at the welt. Attempt 2 fixed the attempt-1 framing failure and additionally reproduced the long belt loop terminating on the welt's top edge, which attempt 1 had missed. Exactly one welt, horizontal, flat, closed, no flap or button; the opposite hip is cropped out so no second welt can appear. Distinguishable from watch-none (a pocket is plainly present) and from watch-both (only one welt in frame). Clean, no annotation bleed, fully photographic.
